functions.name: claim_comparative_analysis

functions.body:
SELECT jsonb_build_object('queued',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='queued'),'running',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='running'),
  'expired_leases',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='running' AND lease_expires_at<statement_timestamp()),
  'retried_active',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status IN('queued','running') AND attempts>1),
  'oldest_queued_seconds',coalesce(max(extract(epoch FROM statement_timestamp()-created_at)) FILTER(WHERE status='queued'),0))
 FROM decision_comparative_analyses WHERE status IN('queued','running');
functions.name: comparative_operational_snapshot

functions.body:
SELECT e.* FROM decision_explanations e
 LEFT JOIN decision_interpretation_sources source ON source.explanation_id=e.id
 LEFT JOIN decision_comparative_analyses a ON a.base_run_id=e.run_id AND a.status='completed'
 WHERE e.run_id=target_run_id
 ORDER BY ((source.analysis_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.id) OR (a.source_mode='existing' AND source.analysis_id IS NULL)) DESC,
  e.created_at DESC,e.id DESC LIMIT 1;

constraints.name: decision_comparative_analyses_base_run_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (base_run_id) REFERENCES decision_runs(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: decision_comparative_analyses_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'running'::text) AND (lease_token IS NOT NULL) AND (lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status <> 'running'::text) AND (lease_token IS NULL) AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL))))

constraints.name: decision_comparative_analyses_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status <> 'completed'::text) OR ((jsonb_typeof(result_json) = 'object'::text) AND (result_fingerprint IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: decision_interpretation_sources_chat_turn_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (chat_turn_id) REFERENCES decision_chat_turns(turn_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: decision_interpretation_sources_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((explanation_id IS NOT NULL))::integer + ((chat_turn_id IS NOT NULL))::integer) = 1))

constraints.name: decision_interpretation_sources_explanation_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (explanation_id) REFERENCES decision_explanations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: decision_interpretation_sources_run_id_analysis_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (run_id, analysis_id) REFERENCES decision_comparative_analyses(base_run_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: decision_interpretation_sources_run_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (run_id) REFERENCES decision_runs(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
